job.title: Brand Manager
job.description:
Hungry for a new Marketing adventure and describe yourself a foodie? Taste buds tempted by a fast-paced role looking after a nation-wide restaurant brand? Salivating at the thought of working in a fun and happy team? Then this exciting Brand Manager role is for you.

You’ll have end-to-end Marketing responsibility for all aspects of this well-known QSR brand, with outlets throughout Australia. You’ll review, adapt and further develop the Marketing strategy, and then deliver all communication planning and campaigns, with a skew to Digital and Social channels. Working closely with other parts of the business, you’ll collaborate on creating new dishes and menus, keeping an eye on market trends and competitor behaviour. You’ll work with Designers and agencies to deliver in-store collateral and point-of-sale, and will act as the brand guardian across all Marketing material. There is a focus on Local Store Marketing too, so you’ll drive Marketing opportunities at a grassroots level also. It’s a busy, dynamic role with lots of projects on the go, so you’ll need to be able to juggle priorities, meet deadlines and work with a wide range of stakeholders.

To succeed in this role you’ll have three to four years’ Marketing experience in a QSR, FMCG or retail business, ideally with Brand responsibility. You’ll need energy, a positive, upbeat approach and a real passion for Marketing. You’ll be reporting directly to the CEO so need to be confident and able to work independently.

The business owns a stable of restaurant brands, all of which are growing rapidly – so a great time to join! They are Marketing-led so there is a lot of respect and support for the Marketing team especially. It’s a harmonious, tight-knit team led by a fantastic CEO who invests in developing his team’s careers. The role offers hybrid working arrangements, and the office is located in an inner-city Melbourne suburb.

A fabulous role for an experienced Marketer looking for an autonomous, fulfilling role.
